Chips at the table are your coins. Packs for those who run a dealer table or play big.

ONLINE TABLE

The dealer is whoever invited friends (“With friends - I deal” in Games; up to 4 players). The dealer doesn't bet but holds the bank: accepts bets (“Accept bets”), deals (“Deal”), reveals the hole card (“Reveal card”) and draws strictly by the rule - to 17 and on soft 17.

A bet can only be accepted if the dealer can cover it: the biggest possible payout is reserved from the dealer's coins for every bet (bet × 1.2; one more bet for a double or split). Bets that can't be covered are rejected and the coins go back to the player.

Players build a bet with 5 / 10 / 25 / 50 / 100 chips, tap “Place bet” and play when their seat is highlighted: Hit, Stand, Double, Split.

Settlement: the dealer wins - the bet goes to the dealer; the player wins - the dealer pays 1 to 1 (blackjack 6 to 5); a push returns the bet. Every round is settled exactly once, even if the connection dropped.

Chips are your coins: “Buy chips” opens the shop. The table is saved for everyone - you can leave and come back, and the table has a chat. If a player doesn't respond, the dealer can skip their turn. A player who leaves loses their bet in the round; if the dealer closes the table, unplayed bets are returned. Betting turnover with one person is limited to 10,000 coins a day.
🏳 %1$s surrenders - half the bet comes back
⏱ %1$s ran out of time - the turn moves on
The limit can be changed while no bets are waiting

TIMER AND ACTIONS
• Every turn has 15 seconds (the bar under the table). If time runs out, the turn moves on (“Stand”). The dealer can “Hurry up” - then 5 seconds remain.
• “Surrender” - on the first two cards: half the bet comes back.
• The dealer plays step by step: “Reveal card”, “Draw a card”, “Stand - settle” (by the rules: draws to 17 and on soft 17) or “Finish now”. Each step also has 15 seconds, then the dealer finishes automatically.
• Before a round the dealer can shuffle the shoe and set the table bet limit.
• Quick phrases - buttons under the table.
